question: Relate the dev-services records to the compute records of the same offer: dev-services/grafana-cloud and compute/grafana-cloud, dev-services/trigger-dev and compute/trigger-dev, dev-services/windmill-cloud and compute/windmill-cloud, dev-services/val-town and compute/val-town each describe one free plan; which record is the home, and should the other be duplicate_of it?
why: the unit scope holds only the new records, so no relate could name a compute record; compute/grafana-cloud also carries category 'cloud VM' and interface unknown for an observability service. compute/sentry and compute/datadog are different offers (open source programmes) and stay separate
